। pUjAmAtreRa vardDante prajA gAvo mahIpateH ॥” tataH prAtargovardDanaM pUjyeti pUrvvAhRatAtparyyakam । dvitIyAsamaye tu sarvvaTA nizidDam । tadyaTA, -- “nandAyAM darSane rakzA balidAnadaSAsu ca । BadrAyAM gokulakrIqA deSanASAya jAyate ॥” purARasamuccaye tu sanBAvitacandrodayadvitIyAsaMyoga eva niziDyate । “gavAM krIqAdine yatra rAtrO dfSyate candramAH । somo rAjA paSUn hanti suraBI pUjakAMstaTA ॥” tadudayasamBAvanaYca nirRayAmfte nirRItam । pratipadyAparAhRikatrimuhUrttavyApinyAM dvitIyAyAM candradarSanaM samBAvyate । taduktamagnyADAnavizaye vfdDaSAtAtapena । “dvitIyA trimuhUrttA cet pratipadyAparAhRikI । agnyADyAnaYcaturddaSyAM parataH somadarSanAditi ॥” aparAhRaSca paYcaDA viBaktasyAhnaScaturToBAgaH । tataSca yatra pratipadi yanmuhUrttavyApinI dvitIyA tatra candradarSanasamBAvanamiti । anyadA tUttarEva pratipattatra gfhItA । taTEva purARasamuccave । “vardDamAnatiTO nandA yadA sArdDatriyAmikA । dvitIyAvfdDigAmitvAduttarA tatra cocyate ॥” kiYca । yadA pUrRapratipat paratra nizkrAmati tadApyuttarEva kAryyA । yaToktaM Bavizyottare । “yaTA dvAdaSaBirmmAsErmmAso vfdDo malimlucaH । taTEvAhorAtrivfdDyA tiTiH prokto malimlucaH ॥ yaTA malimlucaH pUrvvo mAso dEvastaTA paraH । tyAjyA tiTistaTA pUrvvA grAhyA cEva taTottareti nirRayAmftamatam ॥ kintu । vyaYjalInyAyena pUrvvEva mantuM Sakyate । tadvadatrApi devalAdivacanaprAmARyamastIti ॥ * ॥ aTa govardDanapUjAviDiH । pAdma tatreva । “maTurAyAstaTAnyatra kftvA govardDanaM girim । gomayena mahAsTUlaM tatra pUjyo giriryaTA ॥ maTurAyAM taTA sAkzAt kftvA cEva pradakziRam । vEzRavaM DAma sa prApya modate harisanniDO ॥” pUjAmantraH । “govadDana ! DarADAra ! gokulatrARakArakaH । vizRubAhukftocCrAyo gavAM kowiprado Bava ॥” gopUjAmantraH । skAnde tatrEva । “lakzmIryA lokapAlAnAM DenurUpeRa saMsTitA । GftaM vahati yajYArTe yamapASaM vyapohatu ॥ agrataH santu me gAvo gAvo me santu pfzWataH । gAvo me pArSvataH santu gavAM maDye vasAmyaham ॥” aTa gokrIqA । tatrEva । “kroDApayedDAvayecca gomahizyAdikaM tataH । vfzAn karzApayedgopEruktipratyuktibAdanAt ॥” pAdme ca tatrEva । “mahizyAdestaTA BUzA krIqanaM vAraRantaTA ॥” tanmAhAtmyaYca tatrEva । “evaM govardDanaM gASca pUjanIyA viDAnataH । govardDanamaKo ramyaH kfzRasantozakArakaH ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAse kArttikakftye 16 vilAsaH ॥ (puruzottamakzetre BagavatA SaNkarAcAryyeRa pratizWApito maWaviSezaH । iti SaNkaravijayaH ॥ AryyAsaptaSatIpraBftigranTakAra AcAryyaviSezaH । ayameva kavivaraH vaNgADipasya lakzmaRasenasya saBApaRqita AsIt । etanmatasamarTanodAharaRAni kramAnvayena veditavyAni yaTA, AryyAsaptaSatyAm । 702 । “haricaraRAYjalimamalaM kavivaraharzAya budDimAn satatam । akftAryyAsaptaSatImetAM govardDanAcAryyaH ॥” tatrEva wIkAmuKabanDAmyantare । yaTA, -- “govardDanoktisuKadAnanidAnametadvyaNgyArTadIpanamanalpacamatkftInAm .” “govardDanAcAryyasamayastvadyApi samyaN na jYAyate parantvayaM gItagovindakartturjayadevAt prAcInastatsamakAlIno veti vaktuM Sakyate । yato jayadevena gItagovindaprAramBe ‘SfNgArottarasatpraBeyaracanErAcAryyagovardDanaspardDI ko'pi na viSrutaH’ ityuktamasti । jayadevakaviSca vaNgadeSADipasya vallAlasenasUnorlakzmaRasenasya saBAyAmAsIditi SrIsanAtanagosvAminAM matam । ‘govardDanaSca SaraRo jayadeva umApatiH । kavirAjaSca ratnAni samitO lasmaRasya ca ॥’ ityayaM Sloko lakzmaRasenasaBAgfhadvAropari SilAyAmutkIrRa AsIt । tasmAd govardDanajayadevAdayaH sarvve'pi lakzmaRasenasaBAyAmAsanniti kecit ॥”)
